description: Social content ideas from raw draft to finished post. One row per idea, updated in place as it moves through shaping and approval.

fields.description: Short label for the idea, written by the shaping workflow from the draft.
fields.title: title

fields.description: The raw idea as typed into the form.
fields.title: draft

fields.description: Markdown. Each clarifying question the AI asked, followed by the answer given on the form. Unanswered questions are kept with an empty answer.
fields.title: clarifying_qa

fields.description: First proposed content structure: name, hook, beats, call to action, why the angle works.
fields.title: structure_1

fields.description: Second proposed content structure, same shape as structure_1.
fields.title: structure_2

fields.description: Third proposed content structure, same shape as structure_1.
fields.title: structure_3

fields.description: The judge's scoring and reasoning over the three structures.
fields.title: evaluation

fields.description: 1, 2 or 3: the structure the final content is written from. Set by the judge, overridden by the approval link.
fields.title: chosen_structure

fields.description: Random string the approval link must carry. Guards the approve webhook.
fields.title: approval_token

fields.description: When the shaping workflow stored the structures and moved the idea to awaiting_approval. The finalize workflow auto-approves an idea one day older than this.
fields.title: proposed_at

fields.description: When the final content was written.
fields.title: finalized_at

fields.description: approved: you clicked an approval link. auto: the one-day timeout fired and the judge's pick was used.
fields.title: finalized_by

fields.description: Your own notes. No workflow writes this field.
fields.title: notes

title: ideas
